conclusion: Warp reduced full-loop time by 38.58%, but did not reach the native final PSNR. It reached the shared 32.25 dB target 1.293 times faster.
measurement_scope: Official mean-channel PSNR sampled every 100 steps on all 37 held-out half-resolution views. First observed threshold crossing, without interpolation or a saved intermediate checkpoint; single run per backend.

paper_reference.note: Primary speed comparison is native versus Warp on this L40. Comparing to 70 minutes is cross-hardware context only.

limitations: Training uses original upstream gradient masking; numerical counters here cover final evaluation only.
Do not interpret a shorter time than 70 minutes as a hardware-controlled paper speedup.

paper_metric_note: Paper reports Bonsai 32.15 dB. Final Warp is 32.2511 with upstream mean-channel PSNR and 32.1772 with pooled-RGB PSNR. Paper timing uses RTX 4090; our paired measurements use L40.
